market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound to modestly lower over 1–3 months. RBA rate hike risk, mortgage stress, and global bond selloff cap upside. Gold and energy provide sector rotation support. Qantas strike and CTX.AX weakness drag transport. Key swing factor: RBA September decision and CPI print.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Productivity 'bad to worse' and near-recession GDP constrain earnings growth. Housing correction risk (10%) could trigger financial sector NPL concerns. However, gold/rare earths structural demand and energy transition capex support mining sector. AUD likely range-bound 0.62–0.66 vs USD. ASX 200 sees 5,800–6,400 range.
